Once clamps to the last frame / Loop wraps around / PingPong pings 0..n-1..0

anim.frame.zoom_in: Enlarge frame thumbnails (Ctrl+wheel over the grid)

anim.pick.title: Add Frames from Sprite Sheet

anim.pick.meta_hint: The image .meta is written when adding (applies project-wide)
anim.pick.mode_tooltip:
Rect select = drag a rectangle; frames are added row-major
Click select = click cells one by one; frames are added in click order (Godot "As Selected")
anim.pick.zoom_hint: Ctrl+wheel to zoom the image area
anim.copypick.title: Copy Frames from Animation Clip

anim.create.title: Create Animation from Folder

anim.err.saved_hint: √ Saved — effective on next Enter Play (the running game keeps the old snapshot)

New animation (type a name like idle → Enter; the input stays open so you can create several in a row)
Add frames on the right afterwards (+ Add Frame / drag images)

anim.set.duplicate_tooltip: Duplicate animation (reads the source .anim → new file added to the set)

anim.set.play_ro_rename: Cannot rename during Play (the sandbox is read-only) — exit Play and retry
anim.set.play_ro_duplicate: Cannot duplicate animations during Play (the sandbox is read-only) — exit Play and retry
anim.set.dup_name_fmt: The set already contains an animation named "{0}"

anim.set.err_dangling_fmt: × Animation "{0}" has a dangling reference (clip missing / not a clip)

anim.set.err_rescan_missing_fmt: Created, but the rescan did not pick it up (internal inconsistency — please report): {0}

anim.set.err_copied_save_fmt: × The copy file was written but saving the set failed ({0}) — fix the cause and retry

anim.hint_pick_or_new: Pick an animation on the left, or click ＋ to create one
